jobs.title: VP, Data and Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we're the team behind Money Mart—Canada's largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

We've Got You Covered

Compensation Philosophy:
Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

Discretionary Annual Bonus:
Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

Comprehensive Benefits:
Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

Retirement Plans:
Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you're set for the long haul.

Hybrid Work Environment:
Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

Perks and Rewards:
Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

The Job:
Vice President, Data and Enterprise Architecture

What You'll Do

The Vice President, Data and Enterprise Architecture, is responsible for leading Momentum's business and technology on a unified path towards an enterprise target architecture that enables innovation, scalability, and sustainable business growth. This role defines and drives the strategic vision for data, integration, business architecture, and technology platforms —ensuring that architecture and technology investments accelerate business strategy, reduce costs, and position the organization for AI readiness.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of progressive technology leadership in enterprise architecture, data strategy, and platform modernization
Proven experience in rationalizing complex technology environments, reducing technical debt, and delivering measurable cost efficiencies
Demonstrated success leading transformation of large-scale data and technology ecosystems in financial services or similarly regulated industries
Strong track record of building AI- and data-ready enterprise architectures
Experience marrying business architecture with future state architecture

Required Qualifications

Expertise in enterprise data architecture, governance, and analytics
Deep understanding of cloud-native design, integration, and modernization
Strategic ability to balance innovation, performance, and cost optimization
Knowledge of cybersecurity, compliance, and regulatory frameworks
Strong executive communication, influence, and leadership capabilities

Education

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field

Desired Education

Master's degree in Data Science, Cloud Computing, or Enterprise Architecture

Professional Designations (Accreditations, Certificates, Licenses)

Desired Professional Designations

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification
CISSP / CISM (information security)
AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud Architecture certifications

Committed to Equal Opportunity:

MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.

About MFSG – Our Commitment To Responsible Innovation

At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada's Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities.

We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Finance
jobs.description:
Inspirational, innovative and entrepreneurial - this is how we describe our empowered teams. Combine your passion with purpose and join a firm and team that is growing and culture that is thriving in the face of change.

Make an impact with our Corporate Finance team as a Vice President. This diverse team of professionals helps maximize our clients’ potential, enabling them to seize opportunities as they emerge within an evolving business landscape. As a trusted advisor, you’ll provide innovative solutions that support clients’ divestiture, financing, and acquisition objectives.

MNP is proudly Canadian. Providing business strategies and solutions, we are a leading national accounting, tax, and business advisory firm in Canada. Entrepreneurial to our core, our talented team members transcend obstacles into opportunities and continue to transform mid-market business practices.

Responsibilities

Lead the proposal, planning and execution of corporate finance engagements, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and capital-raising transactions.
Manage end-to-end M&A processes, including market research, target identification, buyer outreach, negotiations, and transaction execution.
Lead the delivery of private placement and syndication of financing, including debt, junior capital, and equity.
Conduct regular meetings with clients to review financial and operational results and prepare strategic M&A related performance and to develop strategic, M&A related plans.
Collaborate with and attend meetings with lawyers, bankers, investors, wealth advisors, and other advisors, as required.
Identify competitive dynamics, industry trends, and key performance indicators on both a macro and micro level specific to the target market.
Prepare and review technical analysis, financial projections, forecasts and models.
Design and develop high-quality deliverables including engagement letters, reports, investment memoranda, presentations and correspondence.
Manage engagement economics, including planning, scheduling, budgets, budgets, WIP, billing, and collection.
Identify innovative ways to deliver added value to clients; ensure client needs are met and relationships grow and develop.
Maintain high quality standards and apply specialized knowledge to anticipate, identify and address issues or key risks relevant to the client’s business.
Actively network in the local business community, consider business development opportunities, and lead the preparation and delivery of competitive proposals.
Mentor, motivate, and coach team members towards professional and personal development by setting clear expectations, providing feedback and conducting performance reviews.
Maintain flexibility to travel, as required.

Skills And Experience

Master’s degree in a related field is considered an asset
CPA designation
CBV or CFA designation is considered an asset
5 to 6+ years of professional services experience in M&A or corporate finance
Experience in the transaction advisory services sector assisting clients with due diligence services relating to merger, acquisition or capital raising efforts
Extensive experience in financial analysis and modeling
Experience in business and practice development
Strong communication, management, relationship building, and leadership skills

MyRewards@MNP

With a focus on high-potential earnings, MNP is proud to offer customized rewards that support our unique culture and a balanced lifestyle to thrive at work and outside of the office. You will be rewarded with generous base pay, vacation time, 4 paid personal days, a group pension plan with 4% matching, voluntary savings products, bonus programs, flexible benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, MNP University, a flexible ‘Dress For Your Day’ environment, firm sponsored social events and more!

The annual salary range for this position is: $90,000–$140,000.

Diversity@MNP

We embrace diversity as a core value and celebrate our differences. We believe each team member contributes unique gifts and amplifying their potential makes our business stronger. We encourage people with disabilities to apply!

jobs.title: Director, Data Enablement
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in Data Enablement consulting help organizations unlock value from their data through strategy, governance, analytics, cloud modernization, and AI transformation. We work with clients to establish trusted data foundations, modernize platforms, and enable data-driven decision-making that delivers measurable business outcomes. A career within Consulting services provides the opportunity to help clients transform their businesses through data, analytics, and emerging technologies. As a Director, Data Enablement, you will serve as a trusted advisor to executives, helping organizations shape enterprise data strategies, modernize data ecosystems, and establish AI-ready foundations.

The Opportunity

As a Director, Data Enablement unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

Leadership and Client Advisory

Lead executive-level client engagements focused on data strategy, platform modernization, analytics transformation, and AI readiness.
Build trusted advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, business executives, and other senior stakeholders.
Develop enterprise data transformation roadmaps aligned to strategic business objectives and measurable business outcomes.
Communicate complex technical concepts to business and technology audiences while influencing executive decision-making.
Mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams while fostering innovation and collaboration.

Data Strategy and Business Transformation

Lead enterprise data strategy initiatives that enable analytics, AI, operational effectiveness, and measurable business outcomes.
Assess current-state capabilities and define future-state operating models and transformation roadmaps.
Help clients connect data initiatives to business value and strategic priorities.
Develop business cases and recommendations related to data modernization, information management, and AI adoption.
Advise clients on emerging trends across data, analytics, cloud, and artificial intelligence.

Data Platform Modernization

Lead the design and modernization of enterprise data platforms, including data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and analytics environments.
Guide organizations through migration from legacy on-premise environments to modern cloud-based data platforms.
Assess architecture options, technology investments, business risks, and implementation approaches.
Establish scalable, secure, and governed data ecosystems that support analytics, predictive modeling, and AI workloads.
Develop modernization strategies leveraging cloud-native capabilities to improve scalability, performance, and business value.

Data Governance and AI Enablement

Design and implement enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
Lead initiatives focused on data quality, metadata management, master data management, and compliance.
Establish trusted and governed data assets that support analytics and responsible AI adoption.
Ensure alignment with privacy, security, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Enable AI initiatives through strong data management and platform readiness capabilities.

Business Development and Practice Growth

Lead business development activities, including pursuits, proposals, executive presentations, and solution development.
Build and expand relationships across existing and prospective client organizations.
Contribute to thought leadership and market-facing initiatives in Data Enablement and AI.
Support the development of new offerings, accelerators, and go-to-market strategies.
Drive practice growth and revenue opportunities.

What You'll Bring

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

Minimum 10 years of relevant experience, with 15+ years preferred, in Data & Analytics, Data Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Data Platforms, or Consulting.
Proven experience leading enterprise data transformation and modernization initiatives.
Demonstrated success building modern data platforms and leading migrations from on-premise to cloud-based environments.
Proven ability to shape strategic roadmaps and connect data investments to business outcomes.
Experience advising executive stakeholders and presenting recommendations to C-suite audiences.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across strategy, design, implementation, and delivery.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and client relationship management experience.
Experience leading business development activities, proposals, solutioning efforts, and client presentations.
Experience working within consulting, advisory, or professional services organizations is strongly preferred.
Experience supporting Financial Services and/or Public Sector clients is highly preferred.
Proven success managing complex programs, budgets, resources, and stakeholder relationships.

Technical experience in many of the following areas:

Data Strategy & Enterprise Information Management
Enterprise Data Strategy
Data Governance
Master Data Management (MDM)
Metadata Management
Data Quality Management
Enterprise Information Management
Data Operating Models
Data Stewardship Frameworks

Data Platforms & Analytics

Enterprise Data Warehouses (DW)
Enterprise Data Lakes (EDL)
Lakehouse Architectures
Business Intelligence (BI)
Predictive Analytics
Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Modeling
Star Schema and Relational Data Models
Reporting & Analytics Platforms

Cloud Platforms

Experience with one or more of:

Microsoft Azure
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Modern Data Technologies

Experience with technologies such as:

Databricks
Snowflake
Microsoft Fabric
Azure Synapse Analytics
BigQuery
Amazon Redshift
Enterprise ETL / ELT Solutions

Data Engineering & Security

Data Integration and Data Pipelines
ETL / ELT Design and Development
Data Conversion and Migration Strategies
Data Quality and Data Cleansing
Data Security and Data Protection
Data Masking Technologies
Compliance and Risk Management Frameworks

Preferred Certifications

While not required, the following certifications are considered an asset:

Microsoft Azure Certifications
AWS Certifications
Google Cloud Certifications
Databricks Certifications
Microsoft Fabric Certifications
Enterprise Architecture Certifications
Data Governance Certifications
Practical leadership experience delivering successful business outcomes is valued more highly than certifications alone.

This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.

The salary range for this position is $191,200 - $241,200. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation
jobs.description:
Description

Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation

CTO Office – Information Technology Vice-Presidency (ITVP)

Build the Future with Us

Position Context

At a time when emerging technologies, new delivery models, and evolving customer expectations are reshaping financial services, the Information Technology Vice-Presidency is seeking to strengthen, within the CTO Office, its ability to connect corporate strategy, business capabilities, and transformation roadmaps.

Reporting to the CTO Office, the Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation plays a critical role in turning emerging signals into tangible impacts, actionable roadmaps, and meaningful experiments for the organization. The incumbent embodies an outward-looking CTO perspective, helping guide transformation decisions in close collaboration with business sectors, without replacing business leaders in defining business models or making business investment decisions.

Your Mission

The Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation
is responsible for leading a comprehensive and coherent enterprise business architecture that supports the corporate strategy and organizational transformation initiatives. Acting as both a strategic advisor and a bridge-builder between strategy, business capabilities, and execution, the incumbent monitors emerging trends, evaluates their relevance to iA, proposes evolution roadmaps, and structures experiments that test today what could transform the organization tomorrow.

In complement to the Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture, this role is responsible for business capabilities and value stream architecture, while the other role oversees enterprise technology directions, principles, and architectures.

What You Will Accomplish With Us

Business Architecture

Define and maintain an enterprise-wide business architecture vision encompassing business capabilities, value streams, key processes, and transformation initiatives.
Anticipate the evolution of business capabilities required to support organizational growth and operational efficiency, identify gaps with current capabilities, and guide the paths needed to develop them.
Develop and maintain, in collaboration with business sectors and key stakeholders, business architecture roadmaps that connect corporate strategy, business capabilities, and execution.
Ensure alignment among sector priorities, enterprise capabilities, and transformation roadmaps while supporting strategic trade-offs and key decisions.
Define business architecture standards, artifacts, tools, approaches, and methodologies to support consistent, comparable, and decision-oriented architectural viewpoints across iA.
Contribute, when required, to executive narratives supporting transformation initiatives presented to decision-making bodies.

Strategic Foresight and Innovation

Maintain an active watch on technological, competitive, societal, and organizational trends that may influence the future of financial services.
Identify emerging signals and translate their implications for business capabilities, processes, and target architectures to inform organizational transformation decisions.
Translate observed trends into tangible impacts on business capabilities, processes, platforms, and enterprise transformation priorities.
Contribute to assessing the impact of artificial intelligence and autonomous agents on business capabilities.

Translating Strategy into Capabilities and Execution

Translate strategic directions into business capabilities, transformation roadmaps, implementation paths, and tangible outcomes that can be leveraged by business sectors and the Project Office.
Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, business priorities, organizational capabilities, investments, and transformation initiatives.
Act as a bridge between business leaders, IT teams, and the Project Office to ensure strategic ambitions are translated into executable and clearly understood transformation roadmaps.

Strategy, Business, and Technology Convergence

Serve as the architectural connection point between strategic priorities, emerging trends, business capabilities, and financial services.
Foster a shared understanding among business leaders, IT teams, the Project Office, and partners.
Contribute to aligning business, data, technology, and innovation strategies in collaboration with enterprise architecture, without duplicating its role in technology foundations.
Work closely with the Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture to align business and innovation roadmaps with iAFG’s IT strategy led by Enterprise Architecture.
Collaborate with the leader responsible for Business Models and Business Intelligence by providing a business architecture perspective (capabilities, value streams, and transformation paths) that supports value creation hypotheses, without assuming responsibility for business model design or investment decisions.

Strategic Alignment and Architectural Positioning

Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, business capabilities, and business architecture decisions.
Provide business architecture recommendations and contribute to strategic initiatives presented to the CTO and executive leadership, making impacts, dependencies, and options visible.
Support decision-making by clarifying gaps between strategic ambitions, current capabilities, impacts, dependencies, and implementation options.

Leadership and Team Development

Provide strong leadership to directors and teams through clear direction, senior expertise, and empowerment.
Bring stakeholders together around a common understanding of emerging trends, transformation priorities, and experimentation initiatives.
Develop future-ready capabilities in business architecture, strategic foresight, experimentation, and innovation.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Education and Experience

Relevant university degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Innovation, or a related field.
Significant experience in business architecture, innovation, or organizational transformation, ideally within a complex business environment.
Knowledge of the financial services industry (an asset).
Understanding of emerging technologies and modern transaction models (real-time processing, automated workflows, digital platforms), as well as their potential applications to business capabilities, platforms, processes, and the evolution of financial services.
Demonstrated ability to gain alignment and drive decisions without formal authority among business leaders, technology teams, and executives.

Key Competencies

Strong business acumen, strategic curiosity, and an innovation mindset.
Ability to bring together strategy, business, technology, and financial services perspectives.
Ability to translate strategic directions and emerging trends into roadmaps, business capabilities, experiments, and actionable transformation paths.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills with the ability to put complex issues into perspective.
Clear communication and influence at strategic levels.
Ability to mobilize stakeholders around a shared vision.
Results-oriented approach focused on experimentation, value creation, and transforming ideas into meaningful learning and outcomes.
Understanding of artificial intelligence systems, including autonomous agents and their implications for business processes.
Advanced proficiency in both French and English, as the incumbent will be required to collaborate daily, both verbally and in writing, with unilingual English-speaking partners, teams, and stakeholders across Canada and internationally.

Personal Attributes

Curiosity and an innovative mindset.
Credible leadership and professional presence.
Sound judgment and professional maturity.
Collaborative approach.
Pragmatism and action-oriented mindset.
Adaptability and commitment to continuous learning.

Why You Will Love Working with Us

A work environment where learning and development merge with a collective pursuit of excellence;
Artificial intelligence is in everyone’s hands, helping enhance personal effectiveness and supporting organizational growth;
A healthy, safe, equitable, and inclusive environment where individuals can fully express and develop their potential;
The opportunity to work in a hybrid environment supported by flexibility and access to inspiring, innovative workspaces.

Competitive Benefits

Flexible group insurance plans
Competitive pension plan
Employee share purchase program
Vacation plan and personal wellness and development days
Telemedicine services
Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
Ergonomic furniture program
Performance bonus
Discounts on iA products
And much more!

Apply Today and Take Charge of Your Career

Join us where your talent truly matters.

Not Sure About Applying?

At iA, we believe in potential and value diverse experiences. If this opportunity inspires you, take the leap and apply. Your place may be with us, and we want to get to know you!

Business Architecture

Define and maintain an enterprise-wide business architecture vision encompassing business capabilities, value streams, key processes, and transformation initiatives.
Anticipate the evolution of business capabilities required to support organizational growth and operational efficiency, identify gaps with current capabilities, and guide the paths needed to develop them.
Develop and maintain, in collaboration with business sectors and key stakeholders, business architecture roadmaps that connect corporate strategy, business capabilities, and execution.
Ensure alignment among sector priorities, enterprise capabilities, and transformation roadmaps while supporting strategic trade-offs and key decisions.
Define business architecture standards, artifacts, tools, approaches, and methodologies to support consistent, comparable, and decision-oriented architectural viewpoints across iA.
Contribute, when required, to executive narratives supporting transformation initiatives presented to decision-making bodies.

Strategic Foresight and Innovation

Maintain an active watch on technological, competitive, societal, and organizational trends that may influence the future of financial services.
Identify emerging signals and translate their implications for business capabilities, processes, and target architectures to inform organizational transformation decisions.
Translate observed trends into tangible impacts on business capabilities, processes, platforms, and enterprise transformation priorities.
Contribute to assessing the impact of artificial intelligence and autonomous agents on business capabilities.

Translating Strategy into Capabilities and Execution

Translate strategic directions into business capabilities, transformation roadmaps, implementation paths, and tangible outcomes that can be leveraged by business sectors and the Project Office.
Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, business priorities, organizational capabilities, investments, and transformation initiatives.
Act as a bridge between business leaders, IT teams, and the Project Office to ensure strategic ambitions are translated into executable and clearly understood transformation roadmaps.

Strategy, Business, and Technology Convergence

Serve as the architectural connection point between strategic priorities, emerging trends, business capabilities, and financial services.
Foster a shared understanding among business leaders, IT teams, the Project Office, and partners.
Contribute to aligning business, data, technology, and innovation strategies in collaboration with enterprise architecture, without duplicating its role in technology foundations.
Work closely with the Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture to align business and innovation roadmaps with iAFG’s IT strategy led by Enterprise Architecture.
Collaborate with the leader responsible for Business Models and Business Intelligence by providing a business architecture perspective (capabilities, value streams, and transformation paths) that supports value creation hypotheses, without assuming responsibility for business model design or investment decisions.

Strategic Alignment and Architectural Positioning

Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, business capabilities, and business architecture decisions.
Provide business architecture recommendations and contribute to strategic initiatives presented to the CTO and executive leadership, making impacts, dependencies, and options visible.
Support decision-making by clarifying gaps between strategic ambitions, current capabilities, impacts, dependencies, and implementation options.

Leadership and Team Development

Provide strong leadership to directors and teams through clear direction, senior expertise, and empowerment.
Bring stakeholders together around a common understanding of emerging trends, transformation priorities, and experimentation initiatives.
Develop future-ready capabilities in business architecture, strategic foresight, experimentation, and innovation.
